description: Non-material amendment to development description to introduce 2 development phases, the addition of phasing plan under a revised condition 2 (approved drawings), and new phasing condition (Condition 30).The amended description of development is as follows:Phased construction of a single building to provide residential units, and flexible commercial/community  use  floorspace,  car  and  cycle  parking,  associated landscaping, highways and infrastructure works, and provision of pedestrian and vehicular  access,  to  be  carried  out  in  two  phases  comprising:  Phase  1, piling, foundations  and  other  preparatory  works,  including  excavation  and  associated earthworks; and Phase 2, the remainder of the approved development, including the  basement  slab  and  structure  and  the  building  above (ground to fifth floors), in  accordance  with drawing UPP-BH-A-30-101 Phasing Plan, dated 28 October 2026, subject to Deed of Agreement dated 16th June 2022 and a Deed of Variation dated 17th of October 2024 and Deed of Variation dated 24th of March 2025 under Section 106 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended.of planning permission reference 23/3374 dated 23 October, 2024 (which varied planning permission reference 20/2096 dated 17th June 2022).
